en: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?
Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!
{PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.

Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.
Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?
Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!
